At the medium degrade level, if the capacity constraint persists, the controller will begin to more aggressively redirect traffic away from the affected region and towards nearby regions that have sufficient capacity to handle the additional load.

At the hard shed level, if the capacity constraint becomes so severe that the affected region is no longer able to handle any traffic at all, the controller will initiate a hard shed, which involves immediately and completely redirecting all traffic away from the affected region and towards nearby regions that have sufficient capacity to handle the additional load. This hard shed action is designed to prevent the affected region from becoming a single point of failure that could cause widespread disruption to the overall system.
